Terms

Affiliate terms, in plain English.

  • Commission: 10% of the setup fee and 15% of each monthly payment for the first 12 months, on payments the client has actually made.
  • Commission becomes payable 30 days after the client's payment clears. Refunded or cancelled payments are not commissionable.
  • Payouts: monthly, by bank transfer or Wise, once your balance reaches AED 500.
  • Credit goes to the last affiliate link the client clicked, within 90 days. Existing clients and leads already in our pipeline do not count.
  • No paid ads on the DigiPromise name, no spam, no misleading claims about prices or results.
  • You cannot refer yourself or your own business. We may update the rates for new referrals with 30 days' notice.
FAQ

Affiliate program questions, answered.

Who can join the DigiPromise affiliate program?

Anyone who works with businesses: marketing and web agencies, freelancers, consultants, accountants, business coaches, IT providers and content creators. You do not need to be in the UAE.

How much can I earn?

You earn 10% of the one-time setup fee plus 15% of the client's monthly fee for the first 12 months. On a Growth plan that is about AED 8,020 per client in the first year.

Do I need to sell or do the setup?

No. You introduce the business with your link or code. We run the demo, close the sale, build the agent and support the client.

How is a referral tracked?

Your personal link saves your code in the visitor's browser for 90 days. Every form and chat they start carries your code. The client can also mention your code on the demo call.

When and how do I get paid?

Commission is payable 30 days after the client pays. We pay monthly by bank transfer or Wise once your balance reaches AED 500.

Can I see my referrals and earnings?

Yes. Approved affiliates get a partner dashboard with clicks, leads, won clients and commission. Until it launches, we send a monthly statement.
